evidence_items.explanation: The study evaluates GPT-3, ChatGPT and GPT-4 on multiplication, relational logic puzzles and dynamic programming. Performance deteriorates sharply as compositional complexity increases, supporting the claim that popular models struggle with systematic reasoning.

The researchers find increasingly abstract and cross-language generalization as models grow. This limits a literal interpretation that neural models are only stores of memorized fragments; it does not negate demonstrated systematicity failures.

unresolved_gaps: No numerical standard defines how systematic a reasoning machine ought to be.
